newsitem.title: USA: Norand to expand PC network options.
newsitem.headline: Norand to expand PC network options.

text.p: Norand Corp said Monday it will expand the flexibility of its 6710 wireless network operating system by adding support for its new multi-mode 900 MHz radio PC card.

The company said its 6710 system serves as a bridge between wireless and wired computer networks. The new support will give customers flexibility to choose radio technology that best fits their computer applications, Norand said.
Norand designs and markets mobile computer systems and wireless data communications networks.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Monday at 19-1/4.
